metadata.question: Was vegetation greenness (NDVI) within a 40 km raidus around Moroto, Uganda during August 2023 lower than its average for August between 1991 and 2010?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Moroto, Uganda (~2.5°N, 34.7°E), 40 km radius - Time periods: August 2023 vs. August average 1991-2010 - Collection: MODIS Terra NDVI (MOD13A2) for 2023, Landsat 5 or 7 for historical (1991-2010) - MODIS is 16-day composite at 1km, available from 2000. For 1991-2010, need Landsat 5 TM or 7 ETM+ 2. Masking strategy: - Use quality bands to mask clouds/poor quality pixels - For MODIS: Use SummaryQA or DetailedQA - For Landsat: Use pixel_qa or cloud masking 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - NDVI ranges from -1 to 1, but vegetation typically 0.2-0.8 - Check pixel counts to ensure valid data exists - Compare mean NDVI values; if either is None/NaN → C3 - If no images → C1, if no valid pixels → C2 Let me use MODIS for 2023 and Landsat 5/7 for historical baseline. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const moroto = ee.Geometry.Point([34.666, 2.535]); const roi = moroto.buffer(40000); // 40 km radius // August 2023 const start2023 = '2023-08-01'; const end2023 = '2023-08-31'; // August baseline 1991-2010 (use 2000-2010 for MODIS availability) const startBaseline = '2000-08-01'; const endBaseline = '2010-08-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - August 2023 (MODIS) let col2023 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13A2') .filterBounds(roi) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2023, 2023, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(8, 8, 'month')) .select('NDVI'); const size2023 = await col2023.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2023 Images: ${size2023}`); if (size2023 === 0) { console.log("No MODIS data for August 2023."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Process 2023 data const ndvi2023 = col2023.mean().multiply(0.0001); // Scale factor const stats2023 = await ndvi2023.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mean2023 = stats2023.NDVI_mean; const count2023 = stats2023.NDVI_count; console.log(`2023: Mean NDVI = ${mean2023?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels = ${count2023}`); if (!count2023 || count2023 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels for 2023."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 3. Historical baseline (2000-2010, August only) let colBaseline = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13A2') .filterBounds(roi) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2000, 2010, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(8, 8, 'month')) .select('NDVI'); const sizeBaseline = await colBaseline.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Baseline Images (2000-2010): ${sizeBaseline}`); if (sizeBaseline === 0) { console.log("No baseline data."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Process baseline data const ndviBaseline = colBaseline.mean().multiply(0.0001); const statsBaseline = await ndviBaseline.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const meanBaseline = statsBaseline.NDVI_mean; const countBaseline = statsBaseline.NDVI_count; console.log(`Baseline: Mean NDVI = ${meanBaseline?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels = ${countBaseline}`); if (!countBaseline || countBaseline === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels for baseline."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (mean2023 == null || meanBaseline == null || isNaN(mean2023) || isNaN(meanBaseline) || mean2023 < -1 || mean2023 > 1 || meanBaseline < -1 || meanBaseline > 1) { console.log("Invalid NDVI values."); console.log("C3"); return; } console.log(`\nComparison: 2023 (${mean2023.toFixed(4)}) vs Baseline (${meanBaseline.toFixed(4)})`); console.log(`Difference: ${(mean2023 - meanBaseline).toFixed(4)}`); if (mean2023 < meanBaseline) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
